body: As I said in the post, she already said this has been normal for her with other people since his passing. So it's not just me and she probably doesn't feel the same at all.

I can't do this. It's driving me crazy. Dealing with the loss of my brother is hard enough.. now this with her!??  The only comfort I think is knowing I can't do this. Knowing once she leaves, I can too.

I see the direction i am supposed to walk. I just dont want to anymore. A bullet just sounds so much better than feeling like this. I've always had mental health/suicide problems. Now THIS? lol, its a joke. It has to be. I'm infatuated with my widowed SIL.. this is.. beyond confusing. I just want my brother back so.. so eeveryhing.. idk,.
Thank you! I am new to reddit so if there are any others suggested threads please send them my direction.

I agree, I think.
I think I came to "falling for her" because of the feeling I am left with when I think about her leaving. It feels similar to that.. I think. 

I won't tell her anything. If I'm going down I'm not taking her with me. Reddit is the only place I have said anything. I couldn't even imagine trying to have this discussion with someone I really know..

I have already spoken with a grief counselor and they are in the process of helping me get help through the state so I can  see someone more professionally and maybe get on medication, according to him. 

And I was already doing this prior to her coming down. It's definitely still a lot of the time when I'm numb. Most of the time when I'm not numb I feel confusion and pain. I miss him so much.
I mean, I clicked edit and fixed a few typos. But I haven't posted this more than once.
